headline: ATL @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 5.10 at CHW 3.87, with a projected total of 8.97. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: ATL moved +0.96 runs while CHW moved +0.03, changing the projected margin by +0.93 runs. The projected total climbed +0.99, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Martín Pérez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Miguel Vargas, Ozzie Albies, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Eli White, Dominic Smith because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
